name: Pablo Salamanca y Grimaldi (Grimaldi Revenant, Revenant in the Know)

system.concept: President of El Grupo Salamanca, secretly sabotaging the Sabbat's finances to free his revenant family
system.title: President, El Grupo Salamanca
system.biography:
Background

Pablo heads the Salamanca branch of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} revenant family, which has bankrolled and laundered the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s affairs in Mexico since before Independence. Blood-bound thrall to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} Rafaela Lapaz for 60 years, Pablo watched her burn alive, powerless, when the 1985 earthquake exposed her haven to the sun — the shock of watching his "perfect monster" die as a terrified weakling broke his blood bond to her forever. He now runs El Grupo Salamanca, the family's financial and legal-services empire, from the Torre Latinoamericana.

Roleplaying Hints

Pablo plays the powerless family functionary the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} takes for granted while secretly engineering their deaths: he goads Cainites into disastrous raids and duels, and has built a covert supply network that lures American refugee neonates to Mexico so Salamanca relatives can drain and destroy them, freeing kin from blood bonds one thrall at a time. He suspects Regent Galbraith is an impostor and is quietly protecting that secret because a weak regent suits his sabotage.
system.notes: Revenant family: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} (Salamanca branch). Not a vampire — statted with the npc/vampire schema fields left blank or zeroed where inapplicable (clan, generation, blood pool represents residual vitae dependency rather than a vampire's blood pool). Former domitor Rafaela Lapaz's fleshcrafting transformed his nipples into small fanged, tongued mouths.

vtmlarp.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Three: Characters
